article.title: Remand in other cases.
article.content: Where the Court from whose decree an appeal is preferred has disposed of the case otherwise than on a preliminary point, and the decree is reversed in appeal and a re-trial is considered necessary, the Appellate Court shall have the same powers as it has under rule 23.
article.html:
23ARemand in other cases.

Order 41, Rule 23A

Where the Court from whose decree an appeal is preferred has disposed of the case otherwise than on a preliminary point, and the decree is reversed in appeal and a re-trial is considered necessary, the Appellate Court shall have the same powers as it has under rule 23.

3 Ins. by s. 87, ibid. (w.e.f. 1-2-1977).
